purpose: Per-major isolation slot for UE 5.7. This is NOT a captured inventory and NOT a capability claim source. It exists so 5.7 verdicts are never inherited from the 5.8/5.9 baselines. Populate it from a real 5.7 editor before trusting any answer; see capability_boundaries.md section 8.

engine.note: No 5.7 editor was compiled or run for this skill. Nothing here is engine-verified.

mcp_backend.note: UE 5.7 has no Epic-native ModelContextProtocol plugin in this skill. It routes through a third-party backend selected by live schema, not by version number. Both candidates below are unverified here.

candidates.name: thecodebrozilla/UE_MCP
candidates.kind: 5.8-to-5.7 backport of MCP and most toolsets

candidates.name: AvatarGanymede/ue5.7-mcp
candidates.kind: Win64 5.7 plugin exposing a single 'unreal' tool with action-based protocol

mcp_backend.listener_identity: All paths require an HTTP MCP listener owned by the exact registered UnrealEditor process/project. Do not use native-mcp to bypass that check.

isolation.dimension: data and runtime layers only; the skill package and CLI layer are shared across 5.7/5.8/5.9
isolation.test_project: one module-free ASCII .uproject per version; never reuse the 5.8 CCC bed with 5.7 plugin binaries
isolation.rule: backends.md: an engine version is not a protocol ID. Route by discovered live schema.

capability_claims.policy: Every 5.7 capability verdict is [UNV] until this file is populated from a real editor. Do not inherit [V] or [ABS] from ue583_baseline.json or ue59_baseline.json; namespaces and exposure layers differ across majors.
axes_to_recheck: Axis A: toolset/tool inventory (list_toolsets + describe_toolset or registry JSON)
Axis B: per-domain capability matrix (Blueprint, C++, audio, source control, profiler, MetaSound, GAS, AnimBP, World Partition, opt-in plugins)
Axis C: not-exposed search evidence, re-searched by domain token not name
Section 4 laws: 4.1 file/shell/console, 4.2 enum-array trap, 4.3 modal blockers, 4.4 import gates, 4.5 serialization, 4.6 recompile gates, 4.7 PIE-conditional tools, 4.8 event-dispatcher param limit
GUI: editor visibility, focus, snapshot and level-blueprint open path

capture_checklist: Compile/run a real UE 5.7 editor on a module-free ASCII project path
Register a dedicated instance (ue57) with its own port and backend; verify listener identity
Snapshot the real toolset/tool inventory into the toolsets map and set counts
Run capability_boundaries.md section 7 diff and re-run all axes law-by-law
Flip [UNV] to [V]/[ABS]/[BLOCK] with the 5.7 version and build in each tag
Set verified, engine.changelist, engine.build and capture_method
